name: search_arxiv
description: Search arXiv for papers on a topic. Returns title, authors, year, abstract and arXiv ID.

name: add_paper
description: Save a paper to the signed-in user's library by arXiv ID, e.g. 2401.12345.

name: list_papers
description: List the papers saved in the signed-in user's library, newest first. Returns arXiv ID, title, year and when each was saved.

name: search_library
description: Search the signed-in user's saved papers and return the passages that best match a question, each with its paper title, arXiv ID, relevance score and page. Use it to answer questions about the content of the user's papers. An empty result means the library has nothing relevant.

query.description: The question or topic to look for in the user's papers

arxiv_ids.description: Optional: restrict the search to these papers (arXiv IDs such as 1706.03762)
